newsitem.title: USA: Centex sees FY98 results surpassing FY97.
newsitem.headline: Centex sees FY98 results surpassing FY97.

text.p: Centex Corp said Thursday that its fiscal 1998 financial results should surpass those for fiscal 1997, citing improved performances from its businesses and lower interest rates that have helped home sales.
Centex noted that lower interest rates in recent weeks had favorably impacted home sales and mortgage applications.

The company said home building sales and margins should continue to increase, and fiscal 1998 Home Building results could surpass 1997's record levels if interest rates remain at or near current levels.

The company said it also expects improved performances from its other businesses, including Financial Services and Manufactured Housing, and sees positive results from Contracting and Construction Services.
"Accordingly, Centex said it believes its fiscal 1998 financial results should surpass the historical high levels reported for fiscal 1997," a company statement said.
In fiscal 1997 the company reported earnings of $3.62 a share on revenues of nearly $3.785 billion.
Wall Street is expecting Centex to report fiscal 1998 earnings of $3.74 a share, according to First Call.
